To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the AP-3 adaptor complex is involved in the biogenesis and the secretion of lysosomes in D. discoidea, and that the phenotype of AP-3-deficient cells is similar to that of LYST mutant cells, which suggests that AP-3 and LYST are functionally related.
in the absence of AP-3, the biogenesis of secretory lysosome-derived compartments is altered and the efficiency of their maturation is decreased.

AP-3 is critical for the biogenesis of secretory lysosomal compartments in Dictyosetium cells, and that the biogenesis and fusion of lysosomes are two independent and separable processes in these cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the molecular basis for the biogenesis and function of lysosomes.
the role of the AP-1 adaptor protein complex in the biogenesis and the secretion of lysosomes and lysosome-derived organelles in Dictyosteliam cells.
the biogenesis and the function of lysosomes in the model organism Dictyostelium.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
AP-3 is involved in both the maturation and the fusion of secretory lysosome compartments.
the AP-3-dependent sorting pathway in D. discoideaum is involved in the biogenesis, composition and secretion of late endosomes and lysosomes.
the mu3 gene product is involved in the control of postlysosome biogenesis, and the lvsB gene product in the control of the efficiency of lysosome secretion in Dictyosteliam.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the AP-3 adaptor protein complex is required for normal lysosomal biogenesis and function.
the AP-3 mu3 subunit is involved in the biogenesis and the secretion of lysosome derived compartments in Dictyosteium discoideum.
AP-3 is involved in the maturation of lysosomes and in the secretion of lysosome derived compartments.
The main takeaway from our work is that
AP-3 is involved in the maturation of lysosomes and the secretion of lysosomes.
AP-3 is required for efficient lysosome maturation and secretion in Dictyostelum.
the AP-3 protein complex is required for efficient biogenesis of lysosomes, and that the biogenesis of lysosomal organelles is not a simple process.
